stories.title: Token Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define and implement token data model including fields for token_id, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_version, revoked_flag, and scope. Update persistence layer and validation contracts to support lifecycle enforcement.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No persistent token lifecycle schema exists

stories.title: Token Rotation Logic Service
stories.description: Implement backend service to rotate bearer tokens by issuing a new token with incremented rotation_version, invalidating prior versions, and ensuring atomic swap to prevent race conditions.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No rotation mechanism currently implemented

stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement
stories.description: Implement expiration validation logic that denies access for expired tokens based on expires_at timestamp and ensures all auth paths consistently enforce expiration checks.
